_tuning_notes: Snow leopard: grove + peaks, white coat, a bit tougher for the cold heights. Proves cold-biome species routing alongside the mountain gorilla. Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). RARITY: tier 'rare' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-2, cap 2). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. ECOLOGY 0.4.2: was four raw peak ids, so no Terralith peak qualified. #minecraft:is_mountain covers them plus Terralith's; meadow and cherry grove are excluded as too low and too warm for a snow leopard. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions. TERRALITH PASS: Terralith files volcanic craters, ashen savanna, savanna slopes and even tropical jungle under #minecraft:is_mountain. A snow leopard in any of them is the same class of error as a hippo on the sea floor, so they are excluded.
